result.reason: The clause adds the required annual limit, 30 days’ written notice, business-hours restriction, independent auditor, confidentiality undertaking, and prohibition on systems access. However, the cost shift is triggered by any “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than an underpayment exceeding 5%, so it does not reach the preferred position. It also unnecessarily prohibits access to Licensee’s premises and moves the cost paragraph; the premises prohibition is broader than the playbook and conflicts with the statement that audits will be off-site only “wherever practicable.” The core audit right and mutual-selection concept are otherwise preserved.
